note:
R77 - gen7 EALayer3 v1 inner grammar tested on the r72 vectors, using the maintained public decoder's reading as the hypothesis
(provenance: vgmstream `src/coding/mpeg_custom_utils_ealayer3.c`, read 2026-09-23 from the public repository - not copied; only the
bit layout described there is re-implemented here as a test). Read-only over the banks; temporary rebuilt .mp3 / decoded .wav files
in R77_SCRATCH, removed unless --keep.

Hypothesis (EAL3 v1, per EA-frame = one Layer III granule):
    u8  pcm_flag            0x00 normal, 0xEE = PCM block frame
    u8  common              version(2) sample_rate_index(2) channel_mode(2) mode_extension(2)     <- the observed 0xcc / 0x9c
    [ PCM block frame only: u16 offset_samples, u16 pcm_samples, (v1b: u32 zero) then PCM ]
    bit granule_index (1)
    [ MPEG-1 and granule_index == 1: scfsi (4) per channel ]
    per channel: main_data_size (12) = part2_3_length ; side_rest (47 MPEG-1 / 51 MPEG-2)
    main data: main_data_size bits, then zero padding to the next byte boundary
    next EA-frame starts at that byte.
Tests per block: does the chain of EA-frames tile the payload exactly (T1); granule count vs declared samples / 576 (T2); granule_index
alternation 0,1,0,1 on MPEG-1 (T3); constant header bytes (T4); PCM-flag frames present? (T5). If T1 holds, the granules are rebuilt
into standard MPEG frames (header with bitrate index 14 = 320 / 160 kbps, main_data_begin 0, private bits 0, scfsi as read, the
side-info bits as read, main data concatenated, zero ancillary) and decoded with ffmpeg `mp3float` as a DIAGNOSTIC only (T6): rc,
sample count vs granules x 576 and vs num_samples, RMS. No listening; no encoder; no claim about the game's output.
Usage: python r77_gen7_ealayer3_v1_grammar.py <out.json> [--trees x360-nhl15,ps3-nhl13] [--banks pbp_eng] [--per-bank 8] [--keep] [--no-decode]
